title: settling-coalgebra-structure
description: A settling-equipped predication hyperdoctrine: a predication hyperdoctrine paired with a coalgebra for the settling endofunctor whose knowledge-monotone orbit realizes settling as the 2-categorical spatiotemporal knowledge presheaf.

coalgebra.description: c : E -> F_U(E), a coalgebra for the settling endofunctor F_U on the 2-category of predication fibrations

incrementSequence.description: the parametrizing increment sequence U = (u_tau) for tau < lambda

settlingMonotonicity.description: the orbit (v_tau) from c satisfies sigma <= tau => v_sigma <=_k v_tau pointwise at every predicate and predication cell; v_0 = E, v_{tau+1} = F_U^{tau+1}(E), v_mu = join_k{v_sigma : sigma < mu} at limits
